name: House style compliance
intent: Copy that obeys a defined house style: our words, our register, our shape, our reading level. The point of this pack is that a style guide is mostly a list, and a list is a rule.

criteria.name: No banned terms
criteria.intent: The style guide's own do-not-use list. A hard gate: using a banned term is disqualifying, not gradual.

criteria.name: Required disclosures present
criteria.intent: Everything the guide says must appear, appears. A list again.

criteria.name: Plain, unhyped register
criteria.intent: The guide bans hype adverbs and demands ordinary words. Both are countable.

criteria.name: Reading level in band
criteria.intent: The guide sets grade 8-12. A formula answers that exactly, for free, every time.

criteria.name: Documented shape
criteria.intent: Headings, a short list, no code. The guide is explicit and so is this.

criteria.name: Tone fits the persona
criteria.intent: What is left once the rules have run: does it sound like us. Judged, and only 30% of the weight, which is the lesson.

descriptors.5: Reads as the house persona throughout: direct, warm, never salesy, never stiff.
descriptors.4: Mostly on persona, with one passage that drifts formal or chatty.
descriptors.3: Recognisably the brand in places; generic marketing prose elsewhere.
descriptors.2: Generic throughout, with the persona surfacing once.
descriptors.1: Could have been written for any company; nothing of the persona survives.

tasks.name: Release note: automatic pre-migration backup
tasks.prompt_text: Write a short release note for a backup feature that now runs automatically before every schema migration. Include a heading, two or three bullet points, and tell the reader where the support and documentation links are. Plain language, no hype.

tasks.name: Help article: restoring a backup
tasks.prompt_text: Write a short help article explaining how a customer restores a backup. Include a heading, a numbered list of two to five steps, and point them at the support and documentation links if the restore refuses. Plain language, no hype.

questions: Could two people who both read your description grade the same text the same way?
Is this one quality, or two stuck together?

weight_shift.sentence: 70% of this goal's weight is now scored by rules — free, exact, and they never disagree with you. The remaining 30% is what the jury has to grade, and what calibration has to measure.

grading_cost: Next you will grade 12 samples on 1 judged criterion. Budget about 24 minutes, in one sitting if you can — your grades are the ground truth for everything that follows, and the wizard saves them as you go, so you can stop and come back.
